valid.name: one-shot prototype method setup at module top level - runs once, before any instance exists
one-shot whole-prototype assignment at module top level
valid.code: function Widget() {} Widget.prototype = { run: function () { return 1; } };

valid.name: one-shot Object.assign onto a prototype at module top level
valid.code: function Widget() {} Object.assign(Widget.prototype, { run: function () { return 1; } });

valid.name: class syntax - no prototype mutation node exists at all
reading from a prototype is not modification
assigning a static property is not prototype modification

invalid.name: prototype method assignment inside a function - can run again after instances exist
invalid.code: function Widget() {} function install() { Widget.prototype.run = function () { return 1; }; }

invalid.name: prototype method assignment inside a loop
invalid.code: function Widget() {} for (let index = 0; index < 3; index += 1) { Widget.prototype.run = function () { return index; }; }

invalid.name: whole-prototype reassignment inside a function
invalid.code: function Widget() {} function install() { Widget.prototype = { run: function () { return 1; } }; }

invalid.name: Object.assign onto a prototype inside a function - previously evaded name matching entirely
invalid.code: function Widget() {} function install() { Object.assign(Widget.prototype, { run: function () { return 1; } }); }

invalid.name: Object.setPrototypeOf inside a function
invalid.code: function Widget() {} const base = {}; function install() { Object.setPrototypeOf(Widget.prototype, base); }

invalid.name: __proto__ assignment inside a function
invalid.code: const base = {}; function install(target) { target.__proto__ = base; }

invalid.name: prototype mutation inside a forEach callback - a loop body via LoopContext
invalid.code: function Widget() {} const names = ['a', 'b']; names.forEach((name) => { Widget.prototype[name] = function () { return 1; }; });
